title: Sales Strategy and Operations Senior Associate, Go-to-Market (Mandarin, English)
descriptionHtml:
The Go-to-Market Operations (GTM) team ensures that Google's complex and ever-evolving ads business runs smoothly. We are instrumental in setting the go-to-market strategy and guiding flawless execution and operations against the strategy. We stay focused on aligning the highest-level company priorities with strong day-to-day operations, while also helping to evolve early stage ideas into future-growth initiatives. We have teams embedded in each of the major Ads business areas, as well as global teams that work across the business areas. Team members are analytical with a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.

As a Sales Strategy and Operations Senior Associate, you will be the core engine driving our most critical commercial deals and initiatives (including sales enablement, policy enforcement and ad hoc initiatives). This role demands far more than traditional analytical project management, you are a navigator of complexity and a translator who can bridge high-level commercial incentives with rapid, ground-level business execution.

You will grow in ambiguity and approach issues with a management-consulting mindset, but with a pragmatic, high-velocity bias for action. You don’t just understand structured problem-solving, you know how to bring people along with you. Whether you are untangling a matrixed web of legal, compliance, and sales interests to push a complex agreements across the finish line, or turning global policy enforcement into an empowering sales enablement narrative, you lead with empathy, high emotional intelligence (EQ), and deep commercial acumen.

If you can naturally pivot high-stakes strategy into actual business growth while raising the organizational execution bar, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the trusted expert for complex commercial deals and incentive programs across GCKR. Masterfully navigate cross-functional metrics (Sales, Legal, SF, etc.) to resolve conflicting priorities and move high-stakes deals forward with high velocity and precision.
  • Take highly ambiguous or fragmented business challenges to structured workstreams. Rapidly build scalable execution frameworks for sellers to adopt immediately.
  • Design high-impact enablement initiatives. Translate complex mechanics into persuasive "so-what" narratives to align with executives and inspire sellers.
  • Identify friction points in the current model by using a combination of data-backed insights and exceptional relationship-building to test the status quo, build consensus, and drive process optimization.
  • Oversee program health, risk, and compliance, balancing enforcement with commercial velocity.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in sales operations, management consulting, corporate strategy, commercial program management, or a strategy and operations environment.
  • Experience with data analysis (e.g., SQL, advanced spreadsheets).
  • Ability to communicate in English and Mandarin fluently, to support regional stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiar with digital advertising, media agreement structures, or the GCKR ecosystem.
  • Outstanding presentation skills.
  • Navigates complex matrices to build trust, bridge cultural/functional silos, and rally teams around common goals. Balances opposing priorities with high emotional maturity and a solution-focused mindset under pressure.
  • Breaks down ambiguous challenges with speed and creativity, flexing effortlessly between strategy and ground-level execution.
  • Instantly recognizes the commercial so what in incentives, translating ideas into tangible impact and scalable workflows.

title: Group Product Manager, Information and Infrastructure Protection
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role, you will be responsible for the direction of our endpoint protection portfolio. You will manage a team of Product Managers (PMs) based in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, fostering a culture of technical excellence and user-centricity. You will also have Individual Contributor (IC) responsibilities in key areas. You will drive the global roadmap for endpoint security, bridging the gap between customer insights and engineering. You will develop customer insights and translate them into an actionable roadmap.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year product strategy for enabling Endpoint Security Risk reduction goals, identifying internal and external shifts and other considerations, and translating them into a concrete, actionable roadmap.
  • Manage and coach a regional team of PMs, with responsibility including hiring, performance management, and career development, ensuring the team is motivated and aligned with Google’s security goals.
  • Serve as the site lead for PMs in APAC region, ensuring the region has a voice in global product decisions and fostering collaboration across time zones.
  • Drive the product lifecycle, from initial concept through to global launch and scaled adoption, partnering with Engineering, Technical Program Management (TPgM), and User Experience (UX) to deliver security services with minimal disruption to productivity.
  • Own the end-to-end adoption lifecycle of security policies, translating technical mandates into clear, empathetic communications and low-friction user experiences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 5 years of experience developing or launching products or technologies within security, privacy, or a related area.
  • 5 years of experience in people management, with technical leadership.
  • 5 years of experience building and shipping technical products with Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML).
  • Experience in product management, including strategy development, product roadmapping, and stakeholder management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or a business related field.
  • 7 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, business finance, and other stakeholders.
  • 5 years of experience in software development or engineering.
  • Knowledge in security (especially endpoint security).
  • Knowledge of, or continued interest in building accessibility best practices, and experience/curiosity for incorporating accessibility into product development methodologies.
  • Ability to lead teams across multiple geographies and cultures, specifically bridging APAC regional needs with a US-based Headquarter.

title: Search Ads 360 Lead, Google Customer Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Ireland: €84000 - €86000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Meet business growth goals and optimize adoption and usage of Search Ads 360 across customer portfolio.
  • Act as the Google domain expert and chief point of contact for all things programmatic, especially as a product expert in Google Marketing Platforms and Search Ads 360. Develop, drive, and renew agency partnerships across the organization from account teams to Chief-level stakeholders.
  • Understand client business needs and issues. Lead customer communications, feature prioritization, and resolve client issues.
  • Use key optimization levers, like automation and attribution, to drive performance against our client’s desired customer business outcomes. Consult agency partners on the adoption of Search Ads 360 technology and best practices to drive search marketing success.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders, including Google product, business, marketing, and customer support teams to enable client success and pursue opportunities within accounts.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience working with digital media or digital marketing/advertising solutions, implementing and measuring digital advertising campaigns, and providing client solutions.
  • 4 years of experience in a client-facing role working with partners across multiple levels.
  • Experience in digital advertising, with a focus on Search Engine Marketing (SEM), Paid Search, or advertising technology platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Google Marketing Platform).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with Search Ads 360 or a similar Search Engine Marketing (SEM) ad technology platform for campaign management and media optimization.
  • Experience managing new business or accounts in digital advertising, with a focus on Paid Search.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and building relationships across internal teams with the ability to reach and exceed goals.
  • Ability to develop business contacts within the advertising, marketing and digital industries in EMEA.
  • Ability to understand and absorb technical concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence without authority.

title: Software Engineer III, Fuchsia Subsystem and Connectivity
locations: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will work at the boundary of low-level driver development and modern test automation. You will partner closely with platform driver engineers and system architects to establish automated CI/CQ test pipelines, author multi-device integration tests, and extend host-driven test frameworks such as Lacewing and Test Pilot using Python, Rust, and C++. Additionally, you will help pioneer AI-assisted testing and agentic triage workflows, transforming how test failures are diagnosed and how new driver test suites are generated across the organization.

Fuchsia is a modern, open source operating system that is simple, secure, updatable, and performant. It’s a general purpose OS, designed to power an ecosystem of hardware and software, and provides core operating system functions like system resource management, a driver framework, and software abstractions.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain robust test automation pipelines and host-driven testing integrations using Python, Rust, and C++.
  • Partner directly with Fuchsia platform driver engineers (WLAN, USB, Battery/Power) to define test strategies, author automated CI/CQ tests, and shift test validation earlier in the development lifecycle.
  • Improve multi-device test execution, stabilize physical hardware testbeds in labs, and drive test flake rates asymptotically toward zero.
  • Integrate and leverage AI-assisted test authoring, automated failure triaging, and agentic diagnostics workflows to accelerate release velocity.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering/Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in one or more general-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python/C++) .
  • Experience with low-level OS internals, driver interfaces, or IPC mechanisms (such as FIDL/gRPC).
  • Experience identifying performance bottlenecks with profiling tools.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering/Computer Science or related technical field.
  • Experience with host-driven test frameworks (e.g. Mobly).
  • Experience with developer tooling, test triage automation, or AI/ML-assisted development workflows.
  • Domain expertise in hardware communications/connectivity protocols (WLAN 802.11, Bluetooth, USB, Power/Battery management).

title: Technical Program Manager, Quantum AI
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager for the Quantum AI, Neutral Atoms team, you usher complex, multi-disciplinary quantum computing projects through the entire project lifecycle using your engineering expertise and organizational skills. You will work with hardware system integration stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the organization. You are proactive in driving teams to meet deadlines, track progress, and manage outside vendors and collaborators.

The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Google Quantum AI's mission is to build this computer and unlock solutions to classically intractable problems. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Support Quantum AI research teams by planning project requirements, managing project schedule and supply chain, managing budget, demand forecasting, inventory management, vendor management to enable hardware and software deployment.
  • Anticipate issues and propose solutions, manage dependencies and cross-functional interfaces, and identify the need to develop or improve tools or processes.
  • Document and communicate work plans, timelines, and results to the broader team.
  • Support development and deployment of Neutral Atoms QC research efforts with internal and external stakeholders.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering fields, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program management.
  • 5 years of experience working in systems engineering, hardware development, semiconductor tool development, quantum computing, or related technical fields.
  • Experience managing dependencies and cross-functional interfaces, anticipate issues and propose solutions, and develop tools or processes.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering field.
  • Experience working with emerging technology.
  • Experience any of the following industries: quantum computing, semiconductor tools, complex systems engineering, cryogenics, experimental physics related research, aerospace, or related industries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Global Strategy and Operations Associate, YouTube Marketing
descriptionHtml:
YouTube Marketing’s mission is to know our users, and to connect them to the magic of our products and creators. We make YouTube successful by shaping people’s perceptions of YouTube and inspiring them to engage with us. We’re also responsible for all of YouTube’s marketing activities to consumers, creators, and key opinion influencers.

As a part of YouTube’s Marketing (YTM) organization, Strategy and Operations (S&O) professionals in provide business critical insights and analytics, ensure cross-functional alignment of goals and execution, and help teams drive strategic partnerships and new initiatives forward.

As the Strategy and Operations Associate, you will work with teams in all YouTube geographies and collaborate cross-functionally with key leaders across Marketing, Product, Finance, and People Operations to solve our toughest challenges, execute workstreams on high priority projects, and achieve greater operational excellence within Marketing. You will own the end-to-end strategy and execution for building highly trusted, real-world digital identity credentials in Google Wallet. You will play a pivotal role in helping users create, store, and share their digital identities with third parties in a privacy-conscious, standards-based, and globally interoperable way. By partnering with governments, privacy experts, and third-party issuers, and well as building hero use cases for where users can use their digital IDs, you will help build a trusted global ecosystem that combats fragmentation and delivers highly valuable, reusable digital identity solutions.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end product strategy and execution for building highly trusted, real-world digital identity credentials.
  • Partner with design and engineering teams to define the user experience, prioritize features, and build seamless credential management and sharing capabilities.
  • Drive privacy and policy reviews to ensure the secure and compliant handling of sensitive user information.
  • Collaborate with business development and technical partners to create scalable strategies that foster a globally interoperable digital identity ecosystem for both in-person and online use.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on digital identity, working with cross-functional product teams to integrate credential storage and usage requirements across multiple platforms. Engage with public sector partners and government affairs teams to support standards-based discussions and enable digital identity use cases worldwide.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
  • 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
  • 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
  • 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience in Digital Identity, Know-your-customer (KYC), ID&V or other Identity verification flows, and with consumer product design and developing intelligent, user-centered experiences.

title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager, Google Pixel
descriptionHtml:

You will advocate consumer insights and cultural impact at the forefront of product roadmap development, feature prioritization, and to influence the future-state product. You will have fluency in pulling cultural intelligence and trends into strategies, briefs and execution. title: Chuyên viên hiệu suất, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược
locations: Ho Chi Minh, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Là một Chuyên viên hiệu suất, bạn sẽ thúc đẩy tăng trưởng danh mục sản phẩm ngày càng mở rộng tại thị trường Đông Nam Á. Bạn sẽ chịu trách nhiệm định hình chiến lược sản phẩm tại địa phương, cung cấp sản phẩm thúc đẩy hiệu suất (tìm kiếm, tăng hiệu suất, tạo nhu cầu), thúc đẩy việc sử dụng sản phẩm và tăng trưởng kinh doanh, đồng thời bản địa hoá các kế hoạch tiếp thị với các cộng sự liên phòng ban.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi lớn trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google ở mức giá cạnh tranh trên Google Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường, và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên của khối LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh những công nghệ tiên tiến nhất, làm việc với các quản lý cấp cao, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả thực tế, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Làm chủ và phát triển danh mục khách hàng sử dụng giải pháp tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất. Tăng mức sử dụng bộ tính năng Tối đa hoá AI, chiến dịch Tối đa hoá hiệu suất và chiến dịch Tạo nhu cầu, đồng thời bình thường hoá việc sử dụng AI trong hoạt động tiếp thị.
  • Phát triển và thực thi một chiến lược sản phẩm phù hợp với nhu cầu và thách thức của thị trường Đông Nam Á. Tiến hành nghiên cứu thị trường để xác định các xu hướng mới nổi, nhu cầu của khách hàng và bối cảnh tương tác ở từng quốc gia Đông Nam Á.
  • Làm việc với các nhóm bán hàng, tiếp thị, kỹ thuật và các nhóm khác để đảm bảo quá trình phát triển, ra mắt và sử dụng sản phẩm diễn ra liền mạch.
  • Theo dõi các chỉ báo hiệu suất chính và thúc đẩy cải tiến liên tục trong quá trình sử dụng sản phẩm, cũng như trong việc tương tác và đảm bảo sự hài lòng của khách hàng.
  • Hỗ trợ khách hàng, đảm bảo ý kiến phản hồi của họ được đưa vào lộ trình sản phẩm và các quy trình ra quyết định.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực truyền thông kỹ thuật số, bán hàng, tiếp thị hoặc sản phẩm.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 3 năm kinh nghiệm bán hàng trong ngành công nghệ hoặc quảng cáo.
  • Kinh nghiệm ra mắt sản phẩm ở nhiều thị trường.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng tiếng Anh vì đây là vai trò giao tiếp với khách hàng, đòi hỏi phải trao đổi bằng tiếng Anh với các bên liên quan tại địa phương.
  • Kỹ năng giao tiếp và quản lý nhân sự xuất sắc, cùng khả năng tác động đến các bên liên quan ở mọi cấp bậc.
  • Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc, có khả năng rút ra thông tin chi tiết từ dữ liệu.

title: Solutions Architect, Industry Solutions, Healthcare and Life Sciences
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Solutions Architect in GSD Industry Solutions (Healthcare and Life Sciences), you will combine deep HCLS domain fluency with direct Google Cloud and Generative/Agentic AI engineering expertise to take qualified, complex customer opportunities from defining requirements and architecting solutions through coding, rapid prototyping, implementation, and production rollout.

You will engage directly with customer C-suite, product, clinical, and engineering leaders to architect and build end-state cloud and agentic systems. Operating in a capacity, you will establish technical blueprints on strategic industry priorities, provide technical direction across cross-practice and partner delivery teams, write and review production-grade code for core architectural components aligned to the target architecture, and codify field-proven patterns into repeatable reference architectures, industry agents, and service offerings.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with customer product, clinical, and engineering stakeholders to translate complex healthcare and life sciences requirements into production-grade architectures and directly drive implementation engineering production-level code, building core agentic/RAG and data pipelines.
  • Serve as the lead architectural advisor on strategic engagements, guiding design decisions, unblocking complex engineering challenges through coding, debugging, and performance tuning, data, infrastructure, and AI practices to ensure interoperability.
  • Define and build standardized reference architectures, reusable Agentic workflows, and technical blueprints aligned to priority HCLS transformation themes.
  • Architect and implement verifiable AI evaluation frameworks, PHI data-protection boundaries, source-citation grounding, human-in-the-loop governance into customer solutions.
  • Collaborate with Google Cloud Product Management, Customer Engineering, and Regional Consulting teams to scope strategic engagements.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience as an Enterprise/Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, or Technical Lead designing and delivering enterprise systems in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability, data standards, and regulatory/compliance frameworks across North America and EMEA markets.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Computational Biology or a related technical field.
  • Experience designing hybrid enterprise architectures that combine business rules and data pipelines with multi-agent orchestration and LLM reasoning to meet strict accuracy, auditability, and latency SLAs.
  • Architectural and implementation experience with Google Cloud’s AI, Data, and Healthcare stack (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini, Agent Development Kit (ADK), BigQuery, and Cloud Healthcare API).
  • Demonstrated ability to be a SME, advising executive stakeholders, aligning product requirements documents and statements of work, and guiding cross-functional and global systems integrator engineering teams through code reviews, technical debugging, and problem-solving.

title: Senior Mosquito Biologist, Debug
descriptionHtml:
The Debug team is an interdisciplinary group of mosquito biologists, data scientists, engineers, build technicians, and operations specialists. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions to reduce the impact of mosquito-borne diseases. In collaboration with global partners, we are deploying Wolbachia mosquitoes at-scale to prevent mosquito-borne disease.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to develop and pitch proposals to external stakeholders, design field programs, and operationally implement them in new settings.
  • Design detailed scientific and operational playbooks for implementing new suppression and replacement programs.
  • Characterize the bionomics and performance of new mosquito strains using insectary and field-based bioassays.
  • Test the impact of new rearing and release methods/equipment on mosquito quality.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Entomology, Biological Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience working in insect biology.
  • 5 years of experience in the planning and operational roll-out of public health programs, pest control interventions, or other logistical projects.
  • 5 years of experience in pitching mosquito intervention programs to governments or other relevant stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel internationally 25% of the time.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience in mass rearing and downstream quality assessment of mosquitoes or other insects.
  • Proficiency in data analytics using Google Sheets, R, Python, or similar tools to support daily tasks and reporting.
  • Demonstrated prior experience in modern molecular biology and genomics.

title: Operations Manager, CSCS Deployments
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we aim to foster Googley work environments that are collaborative, friendly and fun. The Facilities Management team brings our spaces to life as you oversee the daily operations of our offices. While roles with similar names at other companies can be far more mundane, you're a creative, organized customer service specialist, who takes pride in seeing things run smoothly and efficiently. You go out of your way to make sure that clients are not only satisfied, but singing Google's praises. You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment with the highest standards of excellence. You aren't afraid to have fun with your job, and bring an enthusiasm, dedication and a collaborative spirit to build and maintain office spaces that facilitate some of the world's most cutting edge innovation.

As a Deployments Operations Manager, you will lead a team of Data Center Technicians and technical staff responsible for deploying and operating the physical infrastructure and server network behind computing environments. In this role, you will deliver critical initiatives, manage day-to-day site operations, and ensure that operational metrics and service level objectives (SLOs) are consistently met. You will serve as an authoritative escalation contact, using data analytics and technical insights to identify systemic trends, resolve complex operational challenges, and implement new automation tools and processes to enhance site efficiency and safety. You will also travel 60% of the time.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $200000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of individuals; set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Partner with teams to meet goals and stakeholders to manage facility activities and set/implement short- and long-term strategies.
  • Maintain, monitor, and execute security and operational procedures and track/analyze trends to identify opportunities for improvements ensuring alignment with organizational policies.
  • Support and contribute to the implementation of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) and other compliance programs and initiatives in collaboration with other teams to ensure environmental and safety incidents are investigated, resolved, and reported.
  • Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in computing infrastructure, networking, operating systems, or hardware.
  • 5 years of experience managing technical, vendor, contract management, or delivery teams.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required and travel 60% of the time.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing operations in large-scale data center environments or third-party colocation facilities.
  • Demonstrated experience initiating and executing strategic operational programs and leading Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) initiatives.
  • Advanced expertise in Linux/Unix system administration, computer networking, optical systems, and hardware architecture.
  • Proficiency in scripting and data analysis tools to automate diagnostics and operational reporting.
  • Strong vendor management and cross-functional stakeholder leadership skills in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

title: Field Sales Manager, Digital Natives and Startups, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. title: Senior Research Scientist, Sensor Technology
descriptionHtml:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

As a Research Scientist at Google, you will lead projects bridging foundational AI, signal processing, and embedded software for future hardware. You will architect multi-modal foundation models, ensuring they operate efficiently within the strict power, compute, and latency constraints of edge devices.

Partnering with hardware technologists, you will co-optimize AI software pipelines with novel sensor architectures driving the lifecycle from research to mass-scale productization. As a technical authority, you will guide cross-functional product and firmware teams to deploy AI-native health features, explore edge AI research, and enhance user experiences through on-device intelligence.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead innovative research and development at the intersection of machine learning, signal processing, and embedded systems for future health and input technologies across Google’s consumer hardware portfolio.
  • Architect and train multimodal machine learning and foundation models tailored for time-series sensor data, while actively optimizing them for real-time inference on resource-constrained embedded systems.
  • Drive hardware-software co-design by partnering tightly with Specialized Hardware Engineers, ensuring that ML architectures and algorithmic requirements directly influence next-generation sensor definitions and edge-compute selection (e.g., MCUs, DSPs, micro-NPUs).
  • Define the long-term technical strategy spanning cloud-based ML training infrastructure down to on-device evaluation, guiding large-scale data collection pipelines and embedded software architecture.
  • Lead cross-functional integration efforts with Hardware, Firmware, Product, and Clinical teams to deploy highly optimized ML models and sensing algorithms into consumer-facing edge devices quickly and broadly.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience working in machine learning research, embedded signal processing, or applied algorithm development for consumer electronics, devices and services, or medical devices.
  • 3 years of experience in technical leadership, guiding research strategy, ML architecture, or algorithmic development for shipping products.
  • One or more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience spanning machine learning research (e.g., time-series foundation models, Generative AI) and embedded software engineering.
  • Experience in digital signal processing (DSP) and extracting meaningful features from noisy, real-world data (e.g., wearable sensor data, physiological signals) using both classical and ML-based approaches.
  • Experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as JAX, PyTorch, or TensorFlow, alongside experience deploying algorithms or models onto embedded systems or edge devices.

  • Expertise in edge AI and hardware/software co-design, particularly optimizing ML models for severely power- and memory-constrained environments (e.g., model quantization, TinyML).
