We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission is to ensure Workspace resilience by providing zero-touch, automated infrastructure for continuous data recovery validation and proactive dependency risk assessment.

We proactively identify and mitigate risks by building infrastructure for automated data recovery testing, fault-injection pipelines, and dependency detection systems that give engineers actionable insights into product stability.

Simulating users across various operational scales, our infrastructure is expected to model the various customer landscape of Workspace. Our team maintains ongoing, close collaboration with first-party application teams and SREs to cultivate unified platform capabilities across the entire Workspace suite.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Write product or system development code.
  • Build internal software products to validate, measure and report Time to Recovery (TTR) end-to-end for various data restore scenarios on an ongoing basis.
  • Lead and manage large-scale data seeding pipelines to support realistic disaster recovery testing and performance validation across Workspace applications.
  • Ensure all work upholds high standards of engineering excellence, including comprehensive test coverage, clear documentation, effective monitoring, and strong debuggability.
  • Provide automated solutions to ensure Workspace apps remain resilient to dependency failures by accurately classifying hard vs soft dependencies and understand and translate stakeholder requirements into robust software solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java and C++).
  • 2 years of experience building and managing distributed software systems and infrastructure.
  • 2 years of experience testing, launching software products, and building developer tools that improve developer velocity, code quality and code health (e.g., compilers, automated releases, code design and testing, test automation frameworks).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms in either an academic or industry setting.
  • 2 years of experience with performance, large-scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, or debugging.
  • 2 years of Chaos engineering, using fault injection frameworks to simulate failure scenarios.
  • 2 years of experience with synthetic data generation, managing pipelines for processing or transferring large datasets.

title: Product Strategy and Go-To-Market Lead, Consumer Payments
descriptionHtml:
Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

As a Product Strategy and GTM Lead for Consumer Payments, you will partner directly with Product Management and cross-functional leaders to shape the strategy, prioritization, and go-to-market execution across the Google Pay and Google Wallet portfolio—including payments, loyalty, gift cards, offers, receipts, digital ID, and travel and transit. Operating at the intersection of product development and market execution, you will handle ambiguous commercial challenges, unblock ecosystem adoption bottlenecks, and turn product capabilities into measurable user and Google-wide value.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $150000 - $217000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional leads to challenge and shape commercial product strategy, pressure-test portfolios, and ground trade-offs in unit economics.
  • Drive go-to-market execution alongside Partnerships, Marketing, and gTech to stand up zero-to-one feature launches and unblock partner adoption bottlenecks.
  • Co-own North Star adoption and transaction metrics by diagnosing end-to-end funnel drop-offs and executing in-market growth experiments.
  • Enable cross-Google product landings by building commercial and product alignment across internal ecosystems to ship unified consumer journeys.
  • Resolve ambiguous, high-consequence problems and unstructured strategic challenges to align executive leadership and drive decisive action.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product operations, product strategy, management consulting, investment banking, go-to-market (GTM) execution, or a strategy and operations role within a technology, fintech, or financial services firm.
  • Experience with payment, financial, or commerce systems.
  • Experience developing and delivering Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies.
  • Experience managing cross-functional projects or program launches involving multiple stakeholders (e.g., Product Management, Partnerships/Business Development, Marketing, or Finance).

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA degree.
  • Experience in GTM strategy execution, including identifying funnel drop-offs, executing growth experiments, or driving product-market adoption.
  • Experience in senior stakeholder management and executive conversations, both written and verbal, internal and external.
  • Experience in mobile, payments industry, digital identity, or online commerce.
  • Experience in the payments industry, digital identity, or online commerce (e.g., digital wallets, card networks, retail banks, merchant loyalty programs, or major fintech platforms, or similar).
  • Tack record of operating autonomously to resolve highly ambiguous, strategic, or operational challenges.

title: Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, Ứng dụng và Trò chơi, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để phát triển trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn mang trong mình niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng gặt hái được nhiều thành công nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google lẫn khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, bạn sẽ là một chuyên gia tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng cho khách hàng thuộc lĩnh vực Ứng dụng và Trò chơi. Bạn sẽ đóng vai trò là một cố vấn tăng trưởng, tận dụng các giải pháp sử dụng AI của Google để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh và cải thiện dấu ấn trên toàn cầu của khách hàng. Bạn sẽ tập trung vào việc phát triển và cải thiện các chiến lược toàn phễu để đáp ứng các Chỉ báo hiệu suất chính (KPI) của khách hàng, chẳng hạn như Lợi tức trên chi tiêu quảng cáo (ROAS) và Giá trị vòng đời của khách hàng (LTV).

Bạn sẽ thúc đẩy sự xuất sắc bằng cách chinh phục khách hàng nhờ những giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hóa hiệu quả các giải pháp quảng cáo của chúng tôi. Bạn sẽ không ngừng chứng minh giá trị và làm nổi bật những thành công đã đạt được nhằm khơi dậy đà tăng trưởng trong tương lai cho khách hàng giữa kỷ nguyên AI đang không ngừng biến đổi.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi lớn trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google ở mức giá cạnh tranh trên Google Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường, và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên của khối LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh những công nghệ tiên tiến nhất, làm việc với các quản lý cấp cao, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả thực tế, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Trở thành chuyên gia sản phẩm, hợp tác với các giám đốc sản phẩm tại các công ty thuộc ngành Trò chơi để điều chỉnh mức chi tiêu tiếp thị cho phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh.
  • Quản lý hiệu suất chiến dịch và phân bổ ngân sách trên bộ sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google (Ứng dụng, Tìm kiếm, Hiển thị, Video), liên tục cải thiện mức chi tiêu để gia tăng Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI).
  • Tiến hành phân tích hiệu suất (ví dụ: phân bổ, thử nghiệm chiến lược, phân khúc đối tượng) để khám phá thông tin chi tiết và giải quyết các thách thức của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích các tập dữ liệu để xác định những điểm tắc nghẽn về hiệu suất, đồng thời đề xuất các chiến lược giá thầu và khung đo lường (ví dụ: SKAdNetwork, GA4).
  • Cung cấp thông tin và vận động sự ủng hộ cho Google khi trình bày các sản phẩm mới, hiệu suất và kết quả của chiến dịch cho khách hàng và công ty quảng cáo.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm tập trung vào tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, tối ưu hoá truyền thông hoặc chiến lược tiếp thị dựa trên dữ liệu.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để giao tiếp với các bên liên quan nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm sử dụng các công cụ phân tích (ví dụ: Google Analytics 4, mô hình phân bổ tiếp thị, trang tổng quan trực quan hoá dữ liệu và phần mềm bảng tính) cùng với kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Hiểu biết về hệ sinh thái ứng dụng, bao gồm cả hoạt động tạo doanh thu và thu nạp người dùng dành riêng cho ngành Ứng dụng và trò chơi.
  • Khả năng gây ảnh hưởng đến các bên liên quan cả trong và ngoài tổ chức để đạt được mục tiêu.

title: SoC Hardware Characterization Lead, Power and Performance
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As the SoC Hardware Characterization Lead, you will be the principal technical owner bridging custom silicon and consumer hardware software teams, you will lead end-to-end post-silicon validation, debugging, and optimization across voltage, frequency, and power-management architectures. In this high-impact leadership role, you will architect scalable hardware-software frameworks to drive platform-level Power and Performance (P&P) optimization, maximize System-on-Chip (SoC) energy efficiency, and ensure system stability for product launch. Serving as the central technical authority across chip design, architecture, product test engineering, and system software, you will align cross-functional partners, streamline manufacturing test screens while safeguarding quality metrics, and lead an engineering team through complex debugging to deliver launch-critical milestones.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Own the bridging chip design, architecture, product engineering, and system software to architect scalable silicon-software frameworks, accelerate power-management deliverables, and drive continuous power, performance, and platform stability optimizations.
  • Direct end-to-end post-silicon validation, characterization, and debugging across advanced voltage, frequency, and power architectures, ensuring physical silicon behavior aligns with architectural intent while driving cross-functional alignment on feature value and product trade-offs.
  • Partner with engineering stakeholders to optimize manufacturing test processes and production screening capabilities, fine-tuning voltage margins while safeguarding product quality standards and defect targets (DPPM).
  • Mentor and guide a high-performing engineering team focused on complex system characterization, including operating limits (Fmax and Vmin), energy efficiency, and root-cause hardware stability debugging.
  • Drive the long-term technology roadmap for sensing subsystems (voltage, current, and temperature) and hardware trigger mechanisms to address rising current densities and industry trends.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of experience with power management or low-power design/methodology.
  • Experience navigating the full product silicon/SoC delivery cycle, from initial architecture definition through to post-silicon productization.
  • Experience with low-power architectures or advanced power optimization techniques.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture or power/performance analysis.
  • Experience with any of the following: product characterization, DVFS governor, power analysis, thermal management, peak power management, in-rush current, PDN droop detection and mitigation, adaptive clock distribution, aging and process monitors, power aware floorplanning, battery technology, concurrency management and thermal management.
  • Exceptional leadership and persuasion skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional roadmaps and drive ROI-based technical decisions.

title: Security Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer, you will help grow our cybersecurity business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will be a trusted advisor to customers and an advocate for our security solutions. You will provide support to C-level, security leaders, cloud security architects and security analysts, using both technical and business skill sets to lead projects forward. You will accompany customers in discovering the technology/solution and consult around the best way to secure and ensure compliance. You will optimize for results when in production, leading with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply the impact of the team.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand customer technical objections, and develop the strategy to resolve technical blockers.
  • Work directly with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments.
  • Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to complete solutions using best practices on Google Cloud.
  • Share security experience to support the technical relationship with customers, including product and solution briefings and proof-of-concept work, partnering with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer engagement with Google Cloud.
  • Support customer-facing presentations and conduct workshops to share the experience and be a subject matter expert on cyber security.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience in a technical sales engineering role in security or cloud native environments.
  • Experience in cybersecurity (e.g., network security, Security Operations Center (SoC) platform, threat detection, malware intelligence, cloud security posture management, or identity and access management systems).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Certification in the Cloud or Security industry.
  • Experience in building and managing AI threat detection and security analytics solutions on Cloud.
  • Experience developing programs/scripts in Python, Java, C++.
  • Experience in architecture and developing software for scalable, distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of public cloud platforms and technical concepts such as Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Platform as a Service (PaaS), Software as a Service (SaaS), Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), and related industry topics.
  • Ability to lead architecture discussions and influence key decision makers around deployment topologies, scaling, performance and sizing.

title: Customer Solutions Engineer, Infrastructure, Google Cloud (Mandarin, English)
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Support team guides customers through the moments that matter in their cloud journey to help businesses grow. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, data centers, and software infrastructure.

In this role, you will provide technical guidance to customers adopting Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services. You will be providing best practices on secure foundational cloud implementations, automated provisioning of infrastructure and applications, cloud-ready application architectures, etc. You will work with Product Management and Product Engineering to drive excellence in Google Cloud products and features.
You will be a part of a global team that provides support to help customers make the switch to Google Cloud. You will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and coding/scripting. You will make the products easier to adopt and use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Provide solutions in cloud platforms and infrastructure; solve cloud platform tests. Create and deliver best practice recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, and sample code.
  • Work with customers to design and implement Cloud based architectures, migration approaches, and application optimizations that enable business goals.
  • Manage the customer’s problem through diagnosis, resolution, or investigation tools implementation to increase productivity for customer issues on GCP products.
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
  • Participate in rotating on-call schedules including during nights, weekends and holidays to ensure prompt and proper resolution of customer-impacting technical tests and travel up to 15% in-region for meetings and onsite delivery activities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience with automating infrastructure provisioning, Developer Operations (DevOps), troubleshooting, advocating for customer needs and managing technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, operating systems, networking).
  • Experience with coding in general purpose languages (e.g., Python, Java, C++), data structures and algorithms, designing enterprise solutions, and supporting customer projects to completion.
  • Experience in testing, maintaining, or launching software products, including design and architecture.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, and holidays as required.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Mandarin fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with SQL database administration, open source software communities, Cloud networking solutions, or distributed computing.
  • Experience in data analytics, warehousing, Extract Transform and Load (ETL) development, data science, or other Big Data applications.
  • Experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning.
  • Experience working in distributed applications or micro-services in a cloud based environment (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience working in a dynamic organization with cross-collaboration across functions.
  • Knowledge in Web application development/deployment, HTTP/RESTful API troubleshooting, or database design/troubleshooting.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

We build the open-source, developer-first orchestration and runtime foundations that power modern AI and autonomous agent workloads.

Our team combines deep distributed-systems and upstream open-source leadership with fast-paced, applied exploration: we build in the open, partner closely with frontier AI labs, external framework and harness maintainers, and open standards foundations, and iterate rapidly with the developer community to shape industry-wide standards for AI and agentic computing.
In this role, you'll define and drive the technical architecture of Google Cloud's open-source agent platform and developer substrate. As a Staff Software Engineer on our team, you will set multi-quarter technical direction across developer experience, stateful agent execution, secure isolation, and ecosystem-wide interoperability.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the multi-quarter technical architecture and roadmap for our open-source agent platform, runtime, and developer experience.
  • Define clean, extensible platform abstractions, APIs, and lifecycle protocols that support stateful, secure, and portable AI agent execution from laptop to cloud.
  • Lead technical alignment across Google Cloud, AI/ML teams, security, and external framework and lab partners to deliver cohesive end-to-end agent workflows.
  • Solve complex challenges balancing zero-friction developer ergonomics with enterprise governance, isolation, and hyperscale performance.
  • Provide technical leadership in the open-source community and standards bodies, cultivating external adoption and mentoring engineers across the team.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, Rust, or C++).
  • 5 years of experience with software design and architecture across distributed systems, developer platforms/tooling, container/virtualization runtimes, or AI/cloud infrastructure.
  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience building/architecting Agentic AI platforms and infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
  • Deep architectural expertise in two or more of: agentic harnesses and runtimes, container/microVM and OS isolation, developer tooling/DX, or Kubernetes/cloud-native control planes in Go.
  • Recognized open-source leadership (maintainer, creator, or specification author in CNCF, AI/agent foundations, or adopted developer tools) and comfort operating in fast-moving spaces between applied research and production engineering.
  • Track record of taking 0-to-1 developer platforms, open-source runtimes, CLIs/SDKs, or AI agent infrastructure from early concept to widespread adoption.

title: Head of Strategic Projects, Go-To-Market, Americas
descriptionHtml:
Google's Global Business Organization (GBO) Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations team sets strategy and drives flawless execution across the complex Ads business. Within GTM, Americas Business Strategy and Operations (ABS&O) partners with Americas Large Customer Sales (ALCS), Google's largest business-carrying unit serving major advertisers across the US, Canada, and LATAM, turning company priorities and early-stage ideas into analytics-backed growth initiatives.

Inside ABS&O, the Strategic Projects team serves as ALCS's strategic incubator, building launchpads that propel Google advertising into its next frontier. We partner with senior leadership to shape core organizational investments, prototype AI-first execution models, and lead cross-organization, leadership-sponsored special projects, grounded in five core values:

  • Win Anyway: deliver impact through any challenge.
  • Lead from the Front: take initiative and set the pace for others.
  • Build Beautifully: hold a high bar for clarity, quality, and impact.
  • Principle Over Process: prioritize what's right over what's convenient.
  • Fun is a Feature: bring energy and positivity.
As Head of Strategic Projects, you will lead this incubator end-to-end, advising VPs and senior executives on critical decisions and shaping the strategic direction of Google's largest commercial business. You will deliver transformational outcomes at pace while building enduring platforms, talent, and partnerships across GTM, Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Product.

Alongside team traits of dynamic problem-solving, ownership bias, and clarity with optimism, you bring enterprise goal to define bold bets, executive judgment to navigate high-stakes ambiguity with discretion and trust, and talent multiplication to grow a high-performing team of Leads and Associates.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $234000 - $325000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design and scale operating models, frameworks, and processes that deliver durable growth and impact for ALCS.
  • Lead initiatives such as shaping organization investments, prototyping AI-first models, and driving leadership-sponsored efforts that bring strategic platforms to life.
  • Own a portfolio of high-trust, high-judgment initiatives sponsored by senior leadership, flexing team capacity to the business's most urgent priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to GBO leaders on key strategic initiatives, framing trade-offs, synthesizing insights into clear recommendations, and shaping the key business decisions.
  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of leads and associates; set the operating model, staffing, and talent standards that make strategic projects a career springboard and a magnet for top talent.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in a management consulting, sales operations, business strategy or corporate advisory role.
  • 5 years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
  • Experience in people management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Economics, Quantitative, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in consulting, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, corporate development, or general management/strategy.
  • Experience advising and influencing C-suite or VP-level executives on high-stakes decisions.
  • Experience with investment allocation, business planning, or capital/resource prioritization in a large commercial organization.
  • Ability to set strategy for and leading large-scale, cross-functional transformations from goal through execution.
  • Ability to build new functions, platforms, or operating models from the ground up and scaling them across a large organization.

title: Logistics Operations Manager, NASA Warehouse Ops
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

In this role, you will oversee and manage day-to-day operations across warehouse facilities. Your primary focus will be directing daily workflows, monitoring material movement, ensuring strict adherence to safety and quality protocols, and supervising on-site site teams. You will handle routine operational challenges, coordinate with logistics partners, maintain operational documentation, and continuously drive operational excellence by optimizing processes to enable rapid business growth, enhance overall productivity, and improve organizational efficiency to support seamless site and regional performance.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $111000 - $159000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage daily logistics operations, material flow, and third-party (3PL) warehouse vendors, including overseeing budgets, invoices, and capital improvements.
  • Monitor SLAs, KPIs, and vendor scorecards to ensure business continuity and build business cases for process and logistics improvements.
  • Design and execute comprehensive forward and reverse logistics strategies aligned with the organization's long-term business goals.
  • Drive technology-driven automation, reduce MTTR, optimize capacity, and eliminate obstacles in material flow to lower operational costs.
  • Partner with internal Google teams, carriers, and external vendors to align priorities, reduce delivery cycle times, and scale operations efficiently.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience building relationships with stakeholders or clients.
  • 5 years of experience identifying issues in processes and creating solutions, and working with cross-functional teams.
  • 5 years of experience in a customer or client-facing role supporting Logistics.
  • 5 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Certified Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or PMP certification, with demonstrated success in business process re-engineering, quality management frameworks or capacity modeling.
  • Experience in data analytics, capacity modeling, and leveraging data to solve complex operational challenges.
  • Experience in Trust and Safety, Content Moderation, Risk Management, or high-volume Customer Support operations.
  • Deep expertise in capacity planning, OpEx budget management, and vendor contract performance governance.
  • Strong executive presence with exceptional written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to influence cross-functional leadership (Legal, Engineering, Product).
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Product, Search AI Experiences
descriptionHtml:
The Search Data Science team's mission is to help Google Search become more helpful as generative AI changes how people find information and get things done. From AI Overviews to AI Mode, Search has evolved beyond answering single questions toward supporting richer, multi-step, and conversational journeys. Our team partners with Product, Engineering, UX, and Research to define what a great AI-powered Search experience looks like, build the metrics and evaluation frameworks that measure it, and use experimentation and deep analysis to guide product decisions. Our work is critical to ensuring Google Search remains the world's most trusted and useful source of information.


In this role, you will work cross-functionally with leads from Engineering, Product, UX, and Research to shape how AI-powered experiences in Search are measured and improved. As AI systems across the industry become more capable at reasoning through complex, multi-step goals, the question of what "success" means for a search journey is evolving. You will help define that answer: developing new metrics and evaluation approaches, designing experiments for complex user flows, and translating findings into product direction. Your work will directly inform the future of Google Search and AI Mode, applying techniques like LLM-based evaluation and causal inference to some of the most consequential product questions at Google. You will work on agentic products at scale and innovate on methodologies for them.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Frame and solve ambiguous product problems and communicate the results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, UX, and Research partners; act as a thought partner and influence prioritization with data.
  • Define success metrics and quality frameworks for multi-step and conversational AI experiences in Search, spanning task completion, efficiency, trust, and user satisfaction.
  • Analyze human and auto-rater evaluations of AI experiences alongside behavioral signals to build a holistic view of product quality.
  • Design and assess live experiments to understand the impact of new AI features on user journeys, and make clear launch recommendations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data science, Engineering, Physics, Economics or a related quantitative field.
  • 8 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, performing statistical analysis, and coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL) or 5 years of experience with a Master's degree.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in statistics, mathematics, data science, engineering, physics, economics or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience analyzing user behaviors in consumer apps, and linking those behaviors to successful business outcomes.
  • Experience working with engineers and product managers especially around providing product-centric insights.
  • Experience in extracting large sets of data with SQL and in designing Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) flows.
  • Experience in developing models (e.g., statistical and causal inference, classification methods).

title: Agentic Marketing Specialist, AI, Google Ads
descriptionHtml:
As an Agentic Marketing Specialist, you will work at the AI-driven marketing, helping the team deploy AI-powered agentic workflows, applying emerging tools and approaches to traditional marketing way of working. You will define and monitor agent behaviors, curate our shared marketing skill library, and maintain the context layers that keep our agents accurate (e.g., brand and product guidelines). You will collaborate in sprints with Product Marketing Managers to safely deploy agents, serving as the bridge between marketing goals and modern generative AI capabilities built by central Marketing Technology (MarTech) and Engineering teams.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in configuring and maintaining the technical pipelines required to run automated, context-aware marketing workflows across core scaled business programs. These workflows will be powered by first-party tools including Antigravity, Gemini Enterprise, and Vertex AI.
  • Help build and curate our shared Skill library by drafting prompt chains and testing tool-calling capabilities that enable agents to execute tasks like content localization, asset generation, and conversational analytics.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing Managers (PMMs) to map organizational marketing knowledge into structured schemas, helping maintain the EMEA Ads Marketing Context Graph and brand guidelines.
  • Participate in changing sprints alongside marketing partners to prototype agentic solutions for high-priority workflows, ensuring configurations align with team templates and best practices.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in marketing (e.g., growth, performance, direct response, social, digital, cloud, events, etc).
  • Experience working cross-functionally with various stakeholders and teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing complex, large-scale projects, including experience in relationship management and change management.
  • Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to solve complex, multi-layered problems and streamline business or development workflows.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a complex organization.
  • Ability to interact with both technical and business stakeholders, and all levels of an organization.

title: Senior Staff Security Engineer, AI Security Standards, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
DeepMind Security and Privacy protects the infrastructure, data, models, and products behind Google's most advanced AI systems. Our mission is to design and uphold high-assurance security postures across the AI lifecycle spanning data protection, large-scale compute and serving infrastructure, and emerging agentic technologies so DeepMind can build and deploy transformative AI safely, securely, and responsibly for the world.

As a Senior Staff Security Engineer for AI Security Standards, you will represent DeepMind's technical security perspective in external standards efforts, industry coalitions, and multi-stakeholder forums shaping how frontier AI systems are secured and deployed. Operating at the intersection of deep security engineering and a rapidly evolving external landscape, you will help define practical, high-bar technical standards covering areas such as data protection, infrastructure security, and agent security that meaningfully reduce risk while remaining grounded in engineering reality. This is a high-impact individual contributor role that bridges the outside world and internal engineering teams. While outward-facing in impact, you will stay deeply anchored inside Google partnering with Security Engineers, Infrastructure Architects, Researchers, Legal, and Policy teams to shape Google's technical positions, identify emerging security challenges, influence external bodies and the direction of the AI industry, and communicate evolving external standards and requirements back to internal teams so Google builds toward the art of the possible.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer varied learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Represent DeepMind's technical security expertise in external standards bodies, industry alliances, and multi-stakeholder technical working groups (such as initiatives like the frontier model forum, RAND security levels, and other emerging national or international AI security frameworks).
  • Author, review, and refine external technical specifications, security control frameworks, position papers, and practical guidance covering data protection, AI infrastructure security, and agentic systems.
  • Navigate ambiguous, fast-evolving problem spaces to identify foundational security challenges and steer both external standards and internal security priorities toward technically sound solutions that align with Google's strengths and direction.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Security, Research, Legal, and Public Policy teams to develop cohesive, technically grounded positions prior to external engagement.
  • Translate evolving external security standards, frameworks, and commitments into clear technical requirements, gap analyses, and strategic roadmaps for internal security and engineering leadership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or related STEM field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in software development, systems programming, or applied ML engineering.
  • 5 years of experience designing and launching production-scale software products or mission-critical foundation AI systems to large-scale user bases.
  • 5 years of experience leading system architecture for high-throughput distributed systems, foundation model runtimes, or client applications.
  • Experience as a technical security leader specializing in data protection, large-scale infrastructure security, or distributed systems security.
  • Experience representing technical security positions externally (e.g., with industry consortia, standards bodies, regulators, or enterprise customers).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Active, or the ability to obtain, a Secret security clearance.
  • Experience securing AI/ML systems, training or serving infrastructure, model assets, or agentic applications.
  • Experience contributing to external security standards, industry consortia, or regulatory technical frameworks.
  • Experience partnering with legal, public policy, and engineering leadership in ambiguous, fast-evolving domains.
  • Expertise in areas such as confidential computing, cryptography, access controls, insider-risk mitigation, or workload isolation.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate external security expectations into practical architectural guidance.

title: Government Affairs and Public Policy Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a Public Policy Manager for Platforms & Devices (P&D) External Engagement EMEA, you will play a leading role in shaping Google’s external advocacy and public policy positions for Android, Google Play, Chrome, and emerging hardware and computing platforms. You will be focused on developing proactive policy positions, representing Google directly before external stakeholders, and conceptualizing and executing creative, high-impact external campaigns. You will act as a primary interface between Google’s product teams and external key opinion formers, including EU and national policymakers, industry coalitions, civil society groups, and digital safety advocates. You will collaborate closely with Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) colleagues across EMEA, as well as an extensive cross-functional work spanning Communications, Marketing, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Trust and Safety.Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

  • Formulate and drive proactive public policy positions and external engagement strategies for P& D across EMEA, aligning regional initiatives with global product goals.

title: Senior Product Manager, Search Content Regulations
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Secure a future for Search by ensuring Google complies with the global mesh of content-focused rules and regulations and articulating a forward-looking strategy that preserves Google’s independence and optionality across the evolving regulatory landscape.

As a Senior Product Manager for Search Content Regulations, you'll play a critical role in shaping the future of Google Search in an increasingly complex global regulatory landscape. You'll sit at the intersection of product, policy, and Trust and Safety, ensuring our systems comply with global content rules while preserving Google's independence. This is a high-visibility role where you'll build the strategies, scalable tools, and cross-functional processes needed to navigate emerging regulations. If you thrive in ambiguous environments and are passionate about protecting user access to information on the open web, this is the perfect opportunity for you to drive company-level impact.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Understand the breadth of applicable global content regulations and their requirements for how the product behaves, the processes it must support (e.g., removals), reporting requirements, and how these requirements are implemented.
  • Develop and promulgate a consistent and durable strategy for the best outcomes in this area, anticipating emerging trends and identifying opportunities to better-position Google in an ever-shifting regulatory landscape.
  • Work with multiple product, Trust & Safety, and compliance teams to ensure full compliance with these regulations and identify opportunities to improve these systems and better align them with product needs and ways of working.
  • Represent the product perspective, emerge regulations and collaborate with policy, legal, and other product teams to develop strategies to ensure regulations are sustainable and well-aligned.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • 5 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
  • 5 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
  • 4 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience understanding complex regulatory dynamics and integrating compliance requirements directly into product features and infrastructure.

title: UX Designer, YouTube Creator Ads
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products. User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”

Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive and elegant user interfaces for YouTube creator monetization and advertising tools.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and user flows.
  • Create detailed wireframes, storyboards, and interactive prototypes to effectively communicate design concepts.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing to gather feedback and iterate on design solutions.
  • Translate complex advertiser and creator needs into simple, actionable UX workflows.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of interaction design experience in product design or UX design.
  • Experience designing workflows or customer user journeys.
  • Experience designing across platforms (e.g., Web, iOS, Android, Wearables).
  • Experience with industry standard design tools (e.g., Photoshop, Illustrator, Sketch, InVisio, Figma, Principle).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in using an iterative, user-centered design process and innovate with AI solutions and collaborate with Ads Platform on future direction.
  • Experience in designing across multiple platforms, and working with technical/design teams to create user flows, wireframes, and building user interface mockups and prototypes.
  • Experience in working with Designers, Researchers, Engineers, Content Strategists, and Product Managers throughout the design process.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Search Quality
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Web Health team's mission is to build user trust by ensuring Google shows a helpful mix of websites across all Search traffic. We achieve this by owning the full ML lifecycle, from developing state-of-the-art models to deploying them directly across Web Ranking and GenAI surfaces.

We are looking for an ML engineer with a deep care for and understanding of the intricate interplay between data, algorithms, objectives and business impact.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.
  • Collect, analyze and visualize data from various sources to formulate and test hypotheses.
  • Design and implement ML systems from training data composition to hyperparameter tuning to post-deployment monitoring and optimizations.
  • Understand and build upon latest technologies such as Gemini foundational models using distillation and fine-tuning.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in C++ or Python.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
  • 3 years of experience specializing in a machine learning field (e.g., foundational models, ML infrastructure, reinforcement learning, or similar areas).
  • 3 years of experience with end-to-end machine learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD (or industry research experience) in ML, AI or related technical fields.
  • Experience in full-cycle development and productionization of machine learning systems.
  • Experience in distilling and deploying production-grade LLMs.
  • Experience programming in Kotlin.

title: Partner Lead, Influencer Marketing Agencies
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As a Partner Lead for the Influencer Marketing Agencies (IMA) book of business, you will manage partnerships across both Global and US APCS (Large Customer Sales) markets. You will work closely with cross-functional teams in YouTube Business, Sales Specialist, and Creative organizations to provide specialized partner support and impactful sales and partner enablement. Your success is measured by the depth to which these partners consider YouTube, integrate Google's AI tools, increase their readiness to invest in creators, and lead to increased brand agreements plus creator asset media business to drive social share of wallet for the largest advertisers.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Own global relationships and execute joint business plans (JBPs) and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to track technical adoption and return on investment (ROI).
  • Act as the central alignment engine between Global Agency teams and regional/local execution teams to implement high-level plans.

  • Drive Google API adoption to eliminate workflow bottlenecks and synthesize partner feedback for the product roadmap.
  • Identify multi-market promoting opportunities and empower partners to pitch Google solutions via scaled training and co-marketing.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of industry experience in advertising, consultative sales, or business development, or 3 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Experience working with advertisers, agencies, or clients.
  • Ability to travel for client meetings and training, as needed.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience navigating complex, matrixed organizations to resolve roadblocks and manage high-level partner escalations.
  • Deep understanding of the influencer marketing lifecycle and how "creator tech" intersects with enterprise advertising.
  • Ability to pivot from C-suite relationship management to technical troubleshooting with Product and Sales Engineering teams.
  • Comfortable discussing technical roadmaps, including API infrastructure, data handling, and AI-enabled SaaS models.

title: Senior ASIC Physical Design Engineer

You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

As an ASIC Physical Design Engineer, you will collaborate with RTL, Design for Testing (DFT), Floorplan, and full-chip Signoff teams. Additionally, you will solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic circuits solutions, while evaluating design options with optimized performance, power, and area in mind.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. title: Research Engineer, Frontier Safety Mitigations, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
Our team focuses on de-risking model launches by defending against critical misuse domains such as Cybersecurity, CBRNE (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, Conventional Explosive), and Harmful Manipulation. Currently, this involves building novel evaluations, red-teaming, researching and deploying advanced mitigations (both in-model and out-of-model), and monitoring emerging risks. We ensure that our mitigations are highly robust, while still enabling the beneficial use of our technology.

GDM is a dedicated scientific community, committed to ‘solving intelligence’ and ensuring our technology is used for widespread public benefit.

The Frontier Safety Mitigation team operates in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. We have a strong culture of support, dedication, and teamwork. We take the possibility of tangibly dangerous model capabilities seriously as AI advances. Because of this, we believe that proactively researching and implementing robust, defense-in-depth mitigations is a critical part of the overall strategy for building safe AI.

We are looking for a research engineer for the Frontier Safety Mitigation team within the Gemini Safety team.

Your core responsibility is to help us build the next generation of safety mitigations for frontier models. This role is highly applied and focuses on building robust, end-to-end defenses against severe risks. This work feeds directly into DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework commitments.

You will be at ease with figuring out how to approach new research questions and implementing technical solutions for them at scale.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.

As a part of the Adversarial Abuse Policy Development team within Trust and Safety, you will operate on the front lines of platform defense. You will not play by traditional rules but rapidly adapt to our defenses, executing coordinated spam campaigns, synthetic media impersonations, and sophisticated monetization scams. As a Policy Development Lead for AI and Adversarial Integrity, you will lead global policy frameworks that address the dual frontier of Artificial Intelligence. You will design durable, machine-enforceable policies to detect and mitigate malicious uses of generative AI, including evasive botnets, mass-produced synthetic slop, and deepfake impersonations. You will pioneer the use of internal generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tooling to analyze complex threat patterns, stress-test policy boundaries, and prototype enforcement frameworks at YouTube scale.

In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between behavioral threat analysis, machine learning engineering, operations, and product strategy. You will unpack adversarial business models and author robust enforcement guidelines that safeguard the YouTube ecosystem.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

descriptionHtml:

While we solve mid- and long-term safety questions for future frontier models, our day-to-day work is grounded in solving real vulnerabilities in live systems. We maintain a sustainable, high-trust research environment where independent thinking is expected, and success is defined by how safe and reliable our models are in the hands of real users.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Prod Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) builds and operates the foundational cryptographic and identity infrastructure that secures Google's planetary-scale production environments and sovereign cloud deployments. Every service, machine, workload, and administrative action across Google relies on our platform for cryptographically verified identity, scoped authorization, and high-assurance trust boundaries.

Our organization is structured around three sub-teams to enable our core user journeys:

  • Identity: Empowers production entities to prove identity and associated security attributes, owning root-of-trust management, full-lifecycle credential issuance, and revocation infrastructure.
  • Platform: Enables Google engineering teams and PKI operators to deploy and operate automated, self-service PKI stacks with minimal operational toil and sustaining cost.
  • Delegation: Enables authenticated principals, distributed workloads, and autonomous AI agents to delegate scoped subsets of permissions dynamically, safely, and transparently.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering

Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.
Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Minimum qualifications:

title: Scientist Developer Relations, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At Google DeepMind, our Antigravity for Science team's mission is to enable and accelerate scientists through Antigravity—making everyday scientific work faster, easier, and higher quality across life sciences, genomics, materials science, earth science, fusion, and mathematics. Alongside Google DeepMind's domain scientists and collaborating closely with the Antigravity and Gemini teams, we build an extensible, local-first scientific workbench—combining domain-specific plugins, interactive sidecars, agents, and scientific evaluations—where Google's frontier science models (such as AlphaFold, AlphaGenome, AlphaEarth, and WeatherNext) work seamlessly alongside open-source community tools and a researcher's own data.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.


We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

You will grow in a fast, dynamic, demanding environment where no two days are ever the same. You will design and deploy detection strategies, countermeasures, and workflows from the ground up to ensure a high-quality, reliable platform experience against adversarial actors.

You will leverage extensive data analysis and ML/AI, identify abuse trends and evaluate the impact of our anti-bot protections on both adversaries and real users. You may be exposed to graphic, controversial, and sometimes offensive video content during team escalations in line with YouTube's Community Guidelines.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

descriptionHtml:

Additionally, you will work with architecture, logic design, and Design for testing (DFT) teams to fully implement cross-functional design requirements.

From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

  • Develop, support and execute implementation flows around industry-standard static timing and parasitic extraction tools.
  • Interface with the broader team to triage and resolve reported technical issues, escalating complex tool-related problems to Electronic Design Automation (EDA) vendors and deliver timely and effective solutions.

Preferred qualifications:
